question: Why must Śiva be explained as having the nature of bliss-consciousness?
premises: Two limiting conditions do not exist in Śiva.
Absence of limiting conditions supports bliss-consciousness nature.
inference: Therefore Śiva must be explained as having the nature of bliss-consciousness.
plain_english: Śiva must be explained as having the nature of bliss-consciousness because of his purity and because those two limiting conditions do not exist in him.
